in_sanskrit.name: Sukla
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who is happy with white, fair, or pure things

in_hindi.name: Suklāl
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुक् (suk) + लाल (lāl) = सुक्लाल (suklāl) = one who is happy with white, fair, or pure things

in_tamil.name: Cuklāl
in_tamil.long_meaning: சு (su) + க்லால் (klāl) = சுக்லால் (cuklāl) = one who is happy with white, fair, or pure things

in_telugu.name: Suklālu
in_telugu.long_meaning: సు (su) + క్లాలు (klālu) = సుక్లాలు (suklālu) = one who is happy with white, fair, or pure things

in_marathi.name: Suklal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suklal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sukla means 'radiant' or 'bright' and Lal is derived from the word 'Lalita' which means 'playful' or 'graceful'. The name Suklal is derived from the combination of these two words and symbolizes a person who is radiant and playful, just like the moon.

in_bengali.name: Suklal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon, Radiant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Suklal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sukla means 'radiant' or 'bright' and Lal is derived from the word 'Lalita' which means 'playful' or 'graceful'. The name Suklal is derived from the combination of these two words and symbolizes a person who is radiant and playful, just like the moon.
